notes.title: Memori One Year Post-Kickstarter Update
notes.content:
[h1]Latest Developments & What’s Ahead for Memori[/h1]

Hello Memori Fans,

As we continue pushing forward with development, I wanted to share some exciting updates and what to expect in the near future. Your support on Steam has been instrumental, and every wishlist, comment, and feedback has propelled us further. Here’s what’s been happening:

[h2]Current Progress:[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Visuals and Art:[/b] With the help of talented artists like [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Ategondev]Ategon Dev[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lesma_pixels]Lesma[/url], player animations have been elevated to new levels. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/styxcolor]StyxColor[/url] has crafted some incredible cinematics, and Cactus Celery has enriched our game world with unique static objects.
    [*][b]Music and Sound:[/b] The soundtrack, particularly the new themes for the main menu crafted by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/flowerheadvgm]Flowerhead[/url], has greatly enhanced the atmospheric feel of Memori. Dive deeper into their creations on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXb6QLCaLxjvucwNlQuS2gg]YouTube[/url].
    [*][b]Gameplay:[/b] We're almost at the finish line with 99% of gameplay locked down, focusing on refining and smoothing out the last few edges.
    [*][b]Skins and Extras:[/b] Final tweaks are being made to our skin system to offer a more personalized and engaging gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h2]What’s Next:[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Early Access in June:[/b] We're gearing up for an early access launch this June. This phase will be crucial for fine-tuning Memori based on your gameplay experiences.
    [*][b]Closed Playtest for Backers:[/b] An exclusive playtest is coming up soon, providing early backers with a sneak peek and the opportunity to shape the final touches.
    [*][b]GDC 2025:[/b] I'll be at GDC, discussing potential partnerships and showcasing Memori. It’s an exciting opportunity to spread the word and gather more support.
    [*][b]Continued Demonstrations:[/b] Keep an eye out for more live demos, both at industry events and online.
[/list]

[h2]Get Involved:[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Join Our Community:[/b] Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/link]Discord community[/url] for live discussions.
    [*][b]Watch Development Live:[/b] Catch our progress and interact on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/practicalnpc]Twitch[/url].
    [*][b]Stay Updated:[/b] Follow us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile]Blue Sky[/url] for the latest insights and announcements.
    [*][b]Everything Else:[/b] Explore more on [url=https://practicalmedia.io/platforms]Practical Media[/url].
[/list]

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your engagement and feedback are shaping Memori into a game we all will love. Stay tuned for more updates as we move closer to launch!

notes.title: Memori Update 0.9.3: Introducing Advanced Physics and Sound Design
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Memori enthusiasts and backers! We're excited to bring you a whirlwind of updates for Chapter 2![/h2]

Brace yourselves, because version 0.9.3 introduces the fan mechanic. This exciting environmental feature throws a whole new element into the mix – the wind! You'll need to master the art of adapting your movements as the wind pushes you around the map. This adds a delightful layer of challenge and strategic platforming to Chapter 2.

[h2]Enhanced Soundscapes and More Immersive World
[/h2]
We've completely revamped our enemy and sound managers. This not only creates a more immersive experience while exploring Memori's captivating world, but also allows us to design intricate enemy encounters and soundscapes in future rooms.

[h2]Expanding the World of Memori
[/h2]
Speaking of rooms, buckle up! We've added a whopping 30 new rooms to Chapter 2, giving you even more stunning environments to explore in your search for your feline friend.
A Feast for the Senses

Immerse yourself further with our addition of high-quality sounds that bring Memori's world to life in all its auditory glory. Plus, a dynamic camera system adds another layer of visual polish to your adventure.

[h2]Secrets Unveiled!
[/h2]
Hold onto your hats, explorers! We've implemented an exciting new progression manager. Keep your eyes peeled for secret walls and gates that respond to collectible pickups. These hidden passages will unlock tantalizing secrets within the game, rewarding your keen sense of exploration.

[h2]Smoother Sailing
[/h2]
And to top it all off, we've improved our room transitions for a seamless and enjoyable gameplay experience.

Get ready to experience a whole new level of challenge and wonder in Memori! We can't wait for you to dive into Chapter 2 and discover all the exciting secrets it holds.

notes.title: Biggest update yet! (Version 0.9)
notes.content:
[h1] 📢New Features in 0.9 [/h1]

[h2] All updates made in version [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42243550/a4b7a9b79173db51f4d0cb59ce755df20befbf2f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New Chapter with Twilight Mechanic:[/b] Experience a complete chapter introducing the Twilight Mechanic, where you traverse the world as an unstoppable ball. This mechanic requires maintaining momentum to move effectively while navigating between the physical and twilight realms.
[*] [b]Enhanced High-Resolution UI:[/b] The user interface has been upgraded to higher resolution, incorporating numerous quality of life (QoL) features. This includes the implementation of an assist mode for accessibility and a debug mode for those interested in exploring the game mechanics more deeply.
[*] [b]Leaderboards:[/b] A new leaderboard system has been introduced, allowing players to compare their speedrunning times against others. This competitive feature adds an extra layer of challenge and community engagement to the game.
[*] [b]Sound Update:[/b] The game now features updated sound effects, ensuring each action and environment feels more satisfying and impactful. These enhancements aim to deepen immersion and enhance the overall gameplay experience.
[*] [b]First Ever Cinematic:[/b] For the first time in the game's history, players will be treated to a cinematic. This addition aims to enrich the storytelling aspect of the game, providing deeper context and emotional engagement with the game's narrative and characters.
[/list]

[h2] Art updates! [/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved art sprites for more detailed and expressive characters and elements.
[*] Enhanced backgrounds, foregrounds, and environmental designs for a more immersive experience.
[*] Advanced parallax effects, adding depth and dynamism to the game's world.
[*] Updated animations and special effects (FX) for smoother and more visually appealing movement and interactions.
[/list]

Get ready for a more immersive and engaging gaming experience!

notes.title: Memori's Next Fest Speedrunning Competition
notes.content:
Calling all Gamers! We are excited to announce an exhilarating Speedrunning Challenge for the thrilling precision platformer, Memori! Brace yourself for an intense race against the clock as you demonstrate your impressive skills, strategic prowess, and lightning-quick reflexes. This challenge will take place during the highly anticipated Steam Next Fest. Get ready to push the boundaries of speed and showcase your expertise in this adrenaline-fueled event!

Starting date: June 19th 
Duration: 1 Week, until June 26th

No matter if you're an experienced speedrunner or a fearless newcomer, this challenge invites everyone to join in. Here's all the essential information you need to know:

Eligibility:
Open to players worldwide.
Must be running on the official demo released on Steam

Category:
Any%: Complete the game as fast as possible.

Submission:
Record your speedrun and submit it via our leaderboard here on [url=https://discord.gg/kYn55n8u3P]Discord[/url] and speedrun.com
Follow the guidelines provided for video formatting and submission requirements.

Rules and Regulations:
All speedruns must adhere to the official ruleset, available on the Speedrun.com leaderboard.
Any use of cheats, exploits, or modifications will result in disqualification.
Multiple submissions are allowed, but only your best run will be considered. (You can't claim all top 3 prizes)

Timing: Speedrunners will be timed from the moment they gain control of the character until the credit scene Runs nominated for the world records must be recorded
Glitches and Exploits: game-breaking glitches and exploits are not allowed.
Timing Method: ingame timer will be used along with your video proof
Sportsmanship: participants must maintain a respectful and sportsmanlike attitude towards each other.
Rule Modifications: We reserve the right to modify or update the rules if necessary, and communicate any changes to participants in a timely and transparent manner.
